title: llz-openbao-platform values
description: Root-strict schema: every top-level key is declared, so a typo (e.g. `openbo:`) is REJECTED AT RENDER instead of silently activating nothing. Nested objects stay permissive on purpose — `openbao` in particular is the upstream subchart's own value tree and must not be constrained from here. Add nested constraints only where a wrong value is as silent as a wrong key.

platform.description: This chart's own platform wiring (releaseName, ESO/PushSecret glue, policies).

openbao.description: Values passed through to the upstream openbao subchart. Deliberately unconstrained — the subchart owns its own schema.

openbaoPromtail.description: Promtail sidecar shipping OpenBao audit logs to Loki.
